attachment.description: A file sent beside the payload with --attach, by its name.

stage.description: The box the animation plays in, in CSS pixels. The view scales it to fit, up to twice its size.

background.description: A CSS colour behind the animation, such as the page it will sit on. Default white.

subject.description: What the animations are for, e.g. Save button: press, saving, saved.

notes.description: Markdown: what this round is, and what to watch.

stage.description: The stage every variant plays on, unless it gives its own. Default 400 × 240 for CSS, the Lottie's own size for Lottie.

reasoning.description: Markdown: the idea, and what to look for.

html.description: A CSS variant: the markup, placed in the body of a page of its own, centred on the stage. <style> elements in it are kept; scripts, links and frames are removed, and nothing is fetched, so images and fonts go in as data: URIs.

css.description: The CSS variant's styles, @keyframes and animation rules. Every animation must run from the moment the page loads: hover, focus and scripts do not happen on the stage. For a loop, stagger with negative animation-delay so the first cycle is already in step.

lottie.description: A Lottie variant: Bodymovin JSON, as a .json file sent with --attach, or inline when it is small. Played by lottie-web's SVG player, without expressions.

duration_ms.description: How long the timeline is, in ms. Default: when the last animation ends (one cycle of a loop) for CSS, from ip to op for Lottie.

loops.description: Whether it repeats in use, like a spinner: side by side it comes round again rather than holding its last frame. Default: true for CSS with an infinite animation, false otherwise.

poster_ms.description: The moment the rail shows it at, in ms. Default half-way.
